paragraphs: St. Lawrence College (SLC) is a public college of applied arts and technology with campuses in Kingston, Brockville, and Cornwall, Ontario. Founded in 1967, SLC serves over 10,000 full-time students and a growing international community, offering certificate and diploma programs in business, technology, health sciences, hospitality, and social services.

Kingston is home to a thriving post-secondary community — including Queen's University and Royal Military College — making it one of Canada's most vibrant university cities. SLC's programs are closely aligned with regional employer needs in healthcare, hospitality, and the public sector.

International students at SLC benefit from a safe, welcoming community environment in Kingston, one of Ontario's most historic and liveable cities. The college provides English language preparation, international student support services, and pathways to further education.

Graduates from eligible SLC programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit. Kingston's growing technology sector and proximity to Ottawa (2 hours) and Toronto (3 hours) provide strong employment and immigration pathways for international graduates.
